limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the unregistered write Gray pointer but also computed registered flags from next-state pointers, changing the cycle-by-cycle full and empty timing that the reference fix preserves.
The scoreboard used the DUT's flags to decide which transfers counted, so it could verify FIFO ordering and capacity without detecting that the flags changed on the wrong cycles.
